why: The Perl control: a package with `use parent`, an explicit `use X qw(f)` import, three subs, and every P2 CALLS shape that never needs a guess — `$self->` (row 1), a bare call resolved via an explicit qw() import (row 5), and a fully-qualified call (row 4). excluded: perl:Shop.Base, perl:Shop.Tax, and perl:Shop.Tax.rate are external — none are declared anywhere in this single-file fixture — and stay out of the node ratio per corpus/README.md's rule; the IMPLEMENTS/IMPORTS/CALLS edges to them above still count.
